name: Cormac Gelta Gáeth
text: Cormac Gelta Gáeth is a legendary ancestor of the Leinstermen. MacKillop's article on him is a single line. It fixes his role as the forebear from whom the people of Leinster descend.

okr.objective: Record the ancestor role of Cormac Gelta Gáeth.
key_results: Name him as legendary ancestor of the Leinstermen.
